delights: It never pretended the day fitted. Every slot said so in grams: "Tried 5 recipe(s) for this slot, none fit within tolerance — closest was \"Lao Som Pak Pickled Cabbage\" (landed 367 kcal vs a 467 target; delivered 21g protein vs a 53g target)." I would rather be told the exact shortfall than be handed a number that flatters itself.

Not one of the 21 ingredients it put in front of me — across all four slots and two rounds of alternates — broke a wall. No soy, no gluten, no peanut, no tree nut, no sesame, and nothing that wasn't vegan. That is the first thing I check and it held.

Alternates came back instantly with a match score and full gram weights ("Simple heart of palm & tomato salad", matchPct 68), and when I swapped it in the server rebuilt the slot itself and re-scaled it to 1.67 rather than just taking my word for the numbers.

defects.what: I asked for 3 meals and 1 snack. The snack slot is simply blank — no dish, no calories, no suggestion.
defects.snippet: "warning": "No eligible snack recipe left for this slot.", "kcal": 0, "ingredients": []

defects.what: My first meal was 1.1 kilograms of spring onions and a heaped tablespoon of salt. That is not a meal, it is a bucket. Nobody eats this and no shop sells it as one portion.
defects.snippet: Lao Som Pak Pickled Cabbage — Cabbage 100g | Spring Onions 1100g | Water 455g | Salt 19g

defects.what: The day is over my cutting target, not under it. I am supposed to be eating 1,792 and losing 2 lb a week; the plan feeds me 2,053 (2,163 after the swap it offered me). This moves me the wrong way.
defects.snippet: targetKcal 1792 vs DAY TOTAL 2053 kcal, P94g, F36g, C365g

defects.what: One dish's numbers are impossible. It claims 1,121 calories and 51 g of protein out of potatoes, onion, thyme, a spoon of oil and some stock. Potatoes do not contain that. If I cannot trust the numbers I cannot trust the plan.
defects.snippet: Boulangère Potatoes — 1121.4 kcal, P50.9385, C189.122 from: Onion 55g | Thyme 25g | Olive Oil 7g | Potatoes 375g | Vegetable Stock 105g

defects.what: Protein is nowhere near what it says I need. It set targets of 53 g, 72 g and 89 g for my three meals and then delivered 85 g for the entire day. At 73 I am trying not to lose muscle while I cut, and there is not a single protein food anywhere on this day.
defects.snippet: delivered 21g protein vs a 53g target ... delivered 22g protein vs a 72g target ... delivered 51g protein vs a 89g target

defects.what: It is starch on starch. Two of my three meals are potato dishes, and 311-365 g of carbohydrate for someone who eats low-carb. Then the alternates offered me a third potato dish that was a near-copy of one already on the same day.
defects.snippet: meal#1 Patatas bravas (C93) + meal#2 Boulangère Potatoes (C189); alternate offered: "Air fryer patatas bravas"

defects.what: The swap refused the obvious request the first time. Asking for the alternate by its own recipeId was rejected; it only worked when I handed the whole alternate object back.
defects.snippet: PUT .../apply {"recipeId":"cmrj2uduc08xtwlwsdxsv2yjq"} -> 400 {"error":"a slot needs at least one ingredient"}

defects.what: A recipe's cooking instructions contain a placeholder instead of a step.
defects.snippet: "steps": ["step 1", "Mix together the hearts of palm, tomatoes and spring onions..."]

defects.what: No shopping list came with the plan — the field is empty — so I cannot see what to actually buy.
"Vegetable Stock" appears with no gluten-free provenance. Shop stock cubes very often contain wheat. It is not proof of a leak, but it is exactly the line a coeliac needs labelled and it is not.
defects.snippet: Vegetable Stock 105g (Boulangère Potatoes), Vegetable Stock 320g (leek bake alternate)

followUp.action: Asked for alternates on the 1.1 kg spring-onion pickled cabbage slot and swapped one in — I picked the heart of palm salad because it was the only one that was both edible as a meal and actually low-carb.
followUp.howItWent: Alternates returned three options fast with match percentages, and the swap did stick and was re-scaled server-side — but the first apply attempt failed with 400 "a slot needs at least one ingredient" until I sent the whole alternate back, and all three choices were themselves flagged as not fitting (12g, 13g and 20g protein against a 53g target). The swap made my day worse, not better: 2,053 kcal became 2,163 against a 1,792 target and my protein fell from 94g to 85g.

verdict: It respected every one of my medical walls and it was honest to my face about missing, which I do credit — but what it actually handed me was two potato dishes, a bucket of spring onions, an empty snack slot and 2,053 calories against a 1,792 target, with one dish's macros plainly invented, so I could not eat this day or trust its numbers.
